verdict.rationale: Grafana Cloud's incident response docs explicitly describe declaring and coordinating incidents, on-call schedules, escalation of alerts, and post-incident review, plus investigating incidents with the same metrics/logs/traces that fired the alert, and acting via Slack/Teams/mobile app. Independent commentary corroborates that Grafana Cloud now bundles incident management alongside alerting. Missing for 10: hands-on/independent verification of escalation-policy configuration depth and timeline UI, and no third-party case study specifically validating on-call scheduling in practice.
